Original User Story: As a site member, I want to describe myself on my own page in a semi-structured way, so that others can learn about me.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a site member, I want to create a semi-structured personal profile on my page so that visitors can easily understand my background, interests, and skills, enhancing community engagement.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Provide a template that includes at least 5 distinct sections (e.g., biography, interests, skills, achievements, and contact information) for users to fill out.

- Allow users to preview their profile before publishing to ensure accuracy and completeness.

Test Outline:
- Verify that the profile template includes the required sections and character limits.
- Check that users can successfully preview their profile before final submission.
- Confirm that the published profile displays all sections correctly and is accessible to other members.
